skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of decision making and decision theory, and apply decision-making processes in business contexts.
Develop logical, systematic, and critical thinking skills to solve business problems.
Utilize various problem-solving methods and tools to address business issues.
Work effectively in teams to make and implement business decisions.
Demonstrate leadership in group settings and manage decision-making processes.
Enhance communication skills for effective decision-making and problem-solving.
Understand and apply game theory to business decision-making scenarios.
Handle decision-making under uncertainty and manage risk.
Make ethical decisions and consider the impact of cultural factors on decision-making.
Apply strategic thinking to enhance business decision-making effectiveness.
Utilize information systems to support business decision-making.
Develop skills to present business decisions and solutions effectively.
Manage time effectively to complete decision-making tasks and assignments.
Adapt to different roles and responsibilities within business management.
Understand and apply corporate social responsibility principles in business management.
